notes.title: Sale, Bug Fixes, and More Exciting News!
notes.content:
Hi all.  It's Mark Radocy, the main developer of Vision Soft Reset.  Shortly after the game's release I accepted a respectable job in the games industry, and I've been working there ever since.  During my employment I was limited with what I could do with my personal creations, which is why VSR hasn't received an update or discount for the past three years.  I know players have wanted this for a while, and I can only apologize for the wait.

[h2]Vision Soft Reset Updates[/h2]

For your patience and understanding, there will be a [b]60% off[/b] sale from May 5 until May 19.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1005450/view/3204884776853762337]An update has also been pushed addressing some major bugs[/url]. 

[h2]What is Seafloor Games LLC?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34232619/fbc959cf97fe520e83ef0017c1474121599b546b.png[/img]

You may have noticed that the Steam page now specifies the developer as "Seafloor Games LLC", what's that about?  [b]Seafloor Games[/b] is a new game development company I created!  Through Seafloor Games I intend to maintain VSR and produce bigger and better games in the future.  This is an intimidating yet exciting step forward for me, and a necessary step to continue doing what I love.

My time in the industry was a rewarding experience that improved my technical skills, soft skills and work ethic.  I grew significantly as a person and even made friends.  And while I greatly enjoyed my time there, my heart remained in indie game development and I wanted to work on my own projects again.  So I made the decision to quit my job and start a new game company, a bold risk that I couldn't possibly have taken without the experience I've gained over the years.

More information can be found at [url=https://seafloorgames.com]seafloorgames.com[/url]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

We at Seafloor Games are hard at work on our next project [b]Moonlight Pulse[/b], a seamless 2D adventure starring multiple characters within a living, breathing world.  We're confident that fans of Vision Soft Reset will enjoy this game too.

More information will be posted on our [url=https://twitter.com/SeafloorGames]Twitter[/url] over the next few weeks.  We'll be sharing info on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y8mRBcpv]Discord server[/url] as well.  If that sounds interesting, consider following us!

Thank you all very much!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 release notes
notes.content:
+ Upgraded Unity version to 2019.4.17f1
+ Changed architecture to x86_64
+ Fixed numbering issue with Seudar Creature Cards.
+ Updated logos in the splash animation.
+ Migrated save files from "Mark Radocy Games" directory to "Seafloor Games LLC".
+ Possibly fixed Oracle appearing upside-down when retrying a boss fight.
+ Disabled distortion effects for the water and boiling water pools.
+ Achieving a speed boost in an underground level is now easier.
+ Changed how the heat distortion effect works.
+ Shaking effect will no longer persist when the game is paused.
+ Sherivice's cry is quieter.
+ Sherivice gives a hint to the wind puzzle.
+ Fixed bug related to encountering the final boss during the meltdown vision.
+ Added a hint for a room that requires use of the claw attack.
+ Made the underwater ghost chase a little easier.
